# Plugin.Maui.Performance

Lightweight mobile performance profiler for .NET MAUI: startup, page navigation, API latency, images, memory, database operations, and a maui profile / MauiProfilingHelper wrapper (`MauiProfile`, `maui-perf`).

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Performance
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Performance
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-performance
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Performance

Registration: `UseMauiPerformance` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I measure MAUI startup and page load time?
- Lightweight mobile profiler without Application Insights
- Trace API vs SQLite vs image load
- How do I wrap maui profile / capture a startup .nettrace?

## Do not use when

- You need a full APM (Application Insights, Sentry performance, App Center)
